svg.text: For the Open Innovation theme, Orbit 9 gives you your own small planet: a ringed world glows behind monospaced digits
while a moon completes one orbit every minute, quietly doubling as a seconds cue. Coral and indigo give strong
contrast to the white JetBrains Mono time, and a single glass complication shows heart rate, steps or your current
episode. Always-on keeps only the time, and the medallion variant frames the planet in a porthole.
368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
